About me

With 7+ years in the creative space, I’ve somehow turned my curiosity into a career in design, videography, photography, marketing, brand strategy, and storytelling.

I like connecting the dots between how a brand looks, sounds, feels, and sells. Whether I’m designing an identity, shooting a video, taking a photo, building a campaign, or shaping the strategy behind it all, I’m usually asking: “What’s the story, and how do we make people care?”

Outside work, you’ll probably find me watching a good movie, working out, or buried in a book. I like creating things, learning things, and occasionally pretending I have enough time for all three.

Basically, I don’t just make things look good. I make them mean something.
